Ghorman, of all places.''"
"''I'm not sure linking anything to Ghorman right now is a good idea.|Mon Mothma to senator|}} A [[Cingulon]] '''senator''' worked for the [[Imperial Senate]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. He had [[color|white]] skin and red [[eye]]s. In [[3 BBY]], he met with [[Senator]] [[Mon Mothma]] who was trying to get votes in the senate to challenge [[Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine's]] extension of the [[Public Order Resentencing Directive]]. During the meeting Mothma presented him with the rise in conviction numbers in peaceful places, like [[Kaifo]], [[Tepasi]] and [[Ghorman]]. He responded by telling Mothma that linking Ghorman to anything then would not be a good idea. While meeting with Mothma he wore a long grey [[robe]] and a large [[necklace]]. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|This was a make-up effect. I always enjoy it when there's a make-up that might work. We called him 'Lettuce Head'. He was played by Nick Kellington. I think for the senators, generally, they gave us a little bit more of an opportunity to show our wares and do a little bit more of a performance, both a performer's performance and an animatronic performance.|[[Neal Scanlan]]|}} The senator was portrayed by [[Nick Kellington]] and appeared in the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', first appearing in the series's fourth episode, "[[Ever Been to Ghorman?]]," which was released on [[Disney+]] on [[April 29]], [[2025]].{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} He was listed in the episode's credits as simply "Senator #4", and was nicknamed "Lettuce Head" during production. ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Ever Been to Ghorman?}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{CelebrationTrailer|[[Andor Season 2|''Andor'' Season 2]]|Celebration Europe (2023)}} {{1stp}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=უცნობი სინგულონი სენატორი }} [[Category:Cingulons]] [[Category:Galactic Empire senators]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]]
